dct_description_sm: A systematic aerial survey of the southeast Beaufort Sea was conducted by the Department of Fisheries and Oceans (DFO) on 22-23 August 2007 and 2-20 August 2008. The objectives of the surveys were to: (1) update knowledge of the distribution and use of the Beaufort Sea by bowhead whales (the last comprehensive survey was flown in 1986), (2) contribute data for the direction of zooplankton sampling efforts amongst feeding whales, (3) contribute data for the interpretation of a concurrent satellite tagging project, and, (4) contribute data for the mitigation of effects of seismic activities on marine mammals in the southeast Beaufort Sea.
dct_title_s: Bowhead Whale Aerial Surveys in the SE Beaufort Sea, 2007-2008
